name: Foongus (CobbleEffort form)
look: a little screw mushroom: a steel Phillips-head dome cap with rivets, a round white body with swirly eyes and a cheery mouth, two threaded screw arms and little copper feet
entry: It burrows into the ground by spinning on the spot, and pokes up its steel cap looking just like a screw that someone dropped. Miners who try to pick it up get a face full of spores.
how: Wild: uncommon in caves deep underground and in abandoned mineshafts.
Evolves into the CobbleEffort Amoonguss at level 39.
